scorecard.summary: DNS records are monitored for additions, removals, and sensitive changes.
Browser security headers and exposed hosting headers are checked.
SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX provider, and spoofing risk are reviewed.
Third-party hosts are categorized and unknown vendors are flagged.
Nikto findings are promoted into customer-readable findings.

findings.title: CSP header is missing
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org does not publish the content-security-policy header.
findings.impact: Missing CSP can reduce browser-side protection for visitors.
findings.recommendation: Add a content-security-policy header at the web server, CDN, or hosting layer.

findings.title: DMARC record is missing
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org does not publish a DMARC policy.
findings.impact: Mailbox providers get less guidance on how to handle spoofed mail.
findings.recommendation: Publish a _dmarc TXT record, starting with p=none for monitoring and moving toward quarantine or reject.

findings.title: Email spoofing risk is high
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org is missing both SPF and DMARC.
findings.impact: Customers, staff, or vendors may receive convincing spoofed messages that appear to come from this domain.
findings.recommendation: Add SPF and DMARC records, then validate them with a follow-up scan.

findings.title: HSTS header is missing
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org does not publish the strict-transport-security header.
findings.impact: Missing HSTS can reduce browser-side protection for visitors.
findings.recommendation: Add a strict-transport-security header at the web server, CDN, or hosting layer.

findings.title: SPF record is missing
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org does not publish an SPF record.
findings.impact: Attackers may have an easier time spoofing mail from this domain.
findings.recommendation: Publish a TXT record beginning with v=spf1 that includes authorized mail senders.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header is missing
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org does not publish the referrer-policy header.
findings.impact: Missing Referrer-Policy can reduce browser-side protection for visitors.
findings.recommendation: Add a referrer-policy header at the web server, CDN, or hosting layer.

findings.title: Unknown third-party vendor observed
findings.summary: cybersecuritypilot.org loads content from cdn.tailwindcss.com, which is not categorized yet.
findings.impact: Unreviewed third-party scripts or assets can introduce availability, privacy, or security risk.
findings.recommendation: Validate the vendor purpose and categorize it as approved or remove it if unnecessary.

findings.recommendation: Add a x-content-type-options header at the web server, CDN, or hosting layer.

findings.title: server header is exposed
findings.impact: Technology disclosure can help attackers fingerprint hosting or application components.
findings.recommendation: Review whether the server header is needed and remove or reduce it when possible.

findings.impact: Technology disclosure can help attackers fingerprint hosting or application components.
findings.recommendation: Review whether the via header is needed and remove or reduce it when possible.
